business_summary: Baotou Dongbao Bio-Tech Co.,Ltd engages in the design, research and development, production, and sale of gelatin and collagen in the People's Republic of China and internationally. It offers pharmaceutical gelation, food additives gelatin, and photographic gelatin; hydrolyzed collagen, collagen peptide, fish collagen peptide, and agglomerated collagen; and private label collagen and unflavored collagen jars. The company also provides organic fertilizers, water soluble fertilizers, and compound microbial fertilizers; and industrial grade calcium hydrogen phosphate and feed grade calcium hydrogen phosphate. In addition, it is involved in the research and development, production, and sale of biological organic fertilizers, as well as empty capsules, as well as sale of terminal collagen. The company's products have applications in thickener, stabilizer, emulsifier, softgel, confection, empty hard capsules, plasma substitute, powder, tablets, beverage, and capsules, as well as fertilizers, animal feeds, industrial fields, etc. Baotou Dongbao Bio-Tech Co.,Ltd was founded in 1960 and is based in Baotou, the People's Republic of China.
